Arne, Baran and Citronimus continued east through Ravenmoor Valley, following the warning Gunther had given them about the missing Ember Seal.

Near the old road they encountered Elira Voss, quartermaster of the Pale Wardens and an old friend of Gunther. Elira normally operates from Blackbridge Watch, where she supplies patrols travelling through Ravenmoor Valley. She confirmed that Gunther had passed through Blackbridge two days earlier while searching for information about the Ember Seal.

Elira introduced the adventurers to Toren Vale, a ferryman and occasional informant who works along the river beneath Blackbridge. Toren is not a member of the Pale Wardens, but he has supplied them with information in the past. He recognized Baran from an earlier journey and claimed that he still owed Baran a favour.

Toren reported seeing three armed travellers carrying crates across the river during the night. One of them wore the black-and-red mark of the Ashen Hand, a faction suspected of smuggling relics and weapons through Ravenmoor Valley.

According to Toren, the group travelled north toward Greyfen Ruins, an abandoned watch settlement beyond Blackbridge. Elira believed the Ashen Hand might be using the ruins as a temporary base.

Before leaving, Elira warned the party not to trust Captain Edric Vane, commander of the Blackbridge militia. Although Vane publicly cooperates with the Pale Wardens, Elira suspects he has been accepting payments from smugglers. Gunther had apparently reached the same conclusion during his investigation.

Arne, Baran and Citronimus decided to travel toward Greyfen Ruins. Their immediate goal was to locate the Ashen Hand smugglers and determine whether the missing Ember Seal had passed through their hands.
